detail: On PR #175 (no daemon change) CI failed once in TestToolHookCost (internal/daemon): one of 1,000 events reached orchd attributed to no session instead of sess-hook; a re-run passed. It also passes 5/5 locally. Likely a load-dependent race in caller resolution of the real orch-hook process on shared runners; worth a look before the enforcing guard relies on pins (a hook resolved to no session is refused while enforcing). Also from the SP-042 verifier (low): perl -i and xargs touch writes are opaque, allowed in block-other-jobs and refused in strict (see RC-111).
